The '''friend''' of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] introduced himself as Anakin's friend, this Pacitthip gave him a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="TPM game" /> While interacting with Qui-Gon Jinn, the Pacithhip wore a green jumpsuit similar to [[Bok Askol/Legends|Bok Askol's]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
